## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes (all gates).
- [ ] No change to pinned content (`sources/`, `**/golden/`, `pipeline/tests/expected/`, `pipeline/tests/fixtures/`), or the change is explained above with the test that proves it.
- [ ] No scripture, commentary, lexicon or dictionary text was altered, and none was generated.
- [ ] A new source or dependency has a justification, its licence, and a `sources/SOURCES.md` row where it applies.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated.
